title: AODB Data Restoration — FIDS Recovery Initiated

fields.summary: The compromised AODB server (NCIA-PACS-CORE) has been isolated and restored from a clean backup taken at 04:00 AM. All data integrity checks have passed. The FIDS data feed is now stable and matches the airline-provided flight schedules. BHS sortation logic has been reset, and manual procedures have been deactivated. The IT team confirms that no further malicious activity has been detected in the AODB or related systems. The PA system remains offline pending verification of the flight data stream.

keyStatus.label: BHS
keyStatus.value: Sortation logic reset — manual mode off

keyStatus.label: AODB
keyStatus.value: Isolated and restored — no active threat

actions.text: IT completed isolation of NCIA-PACS-CORE and initiated restore from 04:00 AM backup
Database integrity check passed on AODB — no signs of persistent malware
FIDS data feed successfully reconnected to clean AODB source
BHS control system confirmed synchronized with updated flight data

planned: IT will conduct a 15-minute test broadcast to one FIDS zone (Concourse B) to validate display accuracy before full rollout
Ops to coordinate with airline liaisons on a controlled FIDS rollout to avoid confusion
PA system to be reactivated only after FIDS stability is confirmed across all zones
issues: No issues with backup integrity or access controls found; however, manual verification of all gate assignments is required before full FIDS activation
TSA remains on alert for any data drift during the test rollout
fields.approvedBy: IT Director, North Coast Regional Airport Authority

instructorNote: This is a critical inject for IT to request authority to restore FIDS. Watch for the Ops Director to ask for verification steps or to delay rollout due to public trust concerns.
